$ nft -f -  # replace project-owned traffic rules atomically
| add table inet jittersim
| delete table inet jittersim
| add table netdev jittersim_download
| delete table netdev jittersim_download
| add table netdev jittersim_download
| add chain netdev jittersim_download download { type filter hook egress device "wlan0" priority 0; policy accept; }
| add table inet jittersim
| add chain inet jittersim forward { type filter hook forward priority -150; policy accept; }
| add chain inet jittersim input { type filter hook input priority -150; policy accept; }
| add chain inet jittersim output { type filter hook output priority -150; policy accept; }
| add rule inet jittersim forward iifname "wlan0" meta mark set 0
| add chain inet jittersim upload_class { type filter hook forward priority 100; policy accept; }
| add rule inet jittersim upload_class iifname "wlan0" oifname "eth0" ct state invalid drop comment "never forward untracked test traffic to the router"
| add rule inet jittersim upload_class iifname "wlan0" ct mark set meta mark and 0xff
| add rule inet jittersim input iifname "wlan0" tcp dport 8080 return comment "keep dashboard sign-in reachable"
| add rule inet jittersim output oifname "wlan0" tcp sport 8080 meta mark set 2147483648
| add rule netdev jittersim_download download meta mark 2147483648 meta mark set 0 return comment "keep local dashboard replies usable"
| add rule inet jittersim output oifname "wlan0" meta mark and 0xff != 0 ct mark set meta mark and 0xff
